items.title: Arista Says Its AI Business Will Double to $7 Billion
items.summary: Arista's CEO just handed Wall Street a 2027 revenue target that blew past consensus by nearly $2 billion, but buried inside that bullish call is a slower-growing business that raises real questions about whether the AI boom can carry the whole company.

The question is whether this rotation has real staying power or just borrowed time.

items.title: Arista Networks Shares Surge 9.6% as Record Q3 Earnings and Strong AI Demand Lift 2027 Outlook
items.summary: Arista Networks (NYSE:ANET) shares surged 9. 6% in premarket trading on Wednesday after the cloud networking company reported record third-quarter 2026 results, exceeding Wall Street expectations for both revenue and earnings while raising its full-year guidance and introducing an ambitious growth forecast for 2027.
